fields.admin_coverage_pct: Reported administrative coverage percentage, if supplied
fields.note: Unmodified narrative note; retained separately from status
fields.start: YYYY-MM-DD for day precision, YYYY-MM for month precision, blank if absent
fields.status: Original PLANNED or CONDUCTED; notes do not overwrite status
fields.year_or_jrf: Original year/JRF label, not assumed to be an event date

fields.admin_doses: Reported administrative doses, admin rows only
fields.admin_target: Reported administrative target; fractional population estimates allowed
fields.coverage_source: admin, official or wuenic; never combined into one estimate
fields.denom_lt1yr: Separate reported independent under-one population estimate
fields.denominator_type: Reported administrative target, or unavailable source-specific denominator
fields.missing_reason: Missingness reason, empty string for observed values
fields.reported_minus_recomputed_pp: Reported minus recomputed administrative percentage in pp
fields.unit: percent, not percentage-point change or relative percent change
fields.year: Calendar year, not a monthly observation

fields.age_group: Claim-specific age group; unspecified where source does not define one
fields.conflict_group: Links conflicting statements or cross-source discrepancies without resolving them
fields.denominator: Source denominator description/uncertainty; no inferred cohort equivalence
fields.denominator_count: Null where the source supplies no claim-specific count denominator
fields.event_end: Explicit period end, or blank where not specified
fields.event_start: Explicit period start, or blank where not specified
fields.event_window_status: explicit, or outbreak context without a stated exact time window
fields.matched_text: Whitespace-normalized matched phrase, not an independent verification
fields.publication_date: WHO publication date, distinct from event window and snapshot month
fields.retrieved_date: Original snapshot retrieval day; exact timestamp unavailable
fields.source_quote: Complete original source line, including original whitespace
fields.source_reported_value: Extracted source statement, not reconciled across contradictions
fields.status: Attributed, not independently verified; unresolved conflict flag where applicable
fields.unit: Explicit cases, percent, source-labeled percent or day-of-month unit

outbreak_evidence.scope: Attributed WHO document statements, not monthly age-specific outcome data

shared.count_unit: Reported cases, not population incidence or infections
shared.missing_numeric_values: JSON null, never a substituted zero; original values retained
shared.numeric_missing_reasons: Per-field missingness; blank=observed, not_supplied=empty source, not_reported/not_applicable/unknown=documented WHO sentinels
shared.raw_fields: Unmodified CSV field strings, where retained as a nested object
shared.source_row: filename:CSV record ordinal including header, first observation=2
shared.source_sha256: SHA-256 of the complete immutable source file, not a row digest

fields.classification: Suspected, clinical, epidemiologically linked, laboratory confirmed, or sum of the three final classifications
fields.count: Nonnegative integer all-age reported count; observed zero is retained
fields.lag_sensitive: True for June–July 2026; exclusion from primary case-study scoring
fields.missing_reason: Missingness reason, empty string for observed values
fields.population: all_ages; no age disaggregation or all-age population denominator supplied
fields.snapshot_month: Source reporting snapshot, not the observation month

surveillance_monthly.scope: Bangladesh only; neighbouring-country records retained unchanged in raw snapshot
